mineoctober.moretotems.tooltip.explosive: Upon activation, it generates an explosion around the player.
mineoctober.moretotems.tooltip.ghastly_t: Upon activation, the player teleports back to their spawn point.
mineoctober.moretotems.tooltip.rotting_t:
Upon activation, the totem summons 3 allied zombies that defend the player from enemies and give the player a unique potion effect called "Necrosis".
"Necrosis" allows the player to regain health from damage and poison potions but makes them lose health when they use health and regeneration potions.
mineoctober.moretotems.tooltip.skeletal_: Upon activation, the totem summons 5 bees that defend the player from enemies.
mineoctober.moretotems.tooltip.stinging_: Upon activation, gives the player a potion effect called "Sniper" that doubles their projectile damage.
mineoctober.moretotems.tooltip.teleporti: Upon activation, gives the player the potion effects of "Levitation", "Slow Falling", and "Fire Resistance".
mineoctober.moretotems.tooltip.tentacled:
Upon activation, gives the player a custom potion effect called "Cephalopod" and the vanilla potion effect "Conduit Power".
"Cephalopod" afflicts any entity attacking the player with blindness and slowness, and afflicts any entity being attacked by the player with blindness.
